title: Decline Renders Clearly
description: A declined card at the dock shouldn't be a silent failure — the customer needs to see why, in plain terms, right where they tried to pay.
successCondition: Paying an open invoice with card number 4000000000000002 (the mock gateway's declined case) keeps the invoice's Badge showing "open", and the payment attempt list gains one new line reading "Attempt 1: declined (card_declined: insufficient funds)" — visible on the page without needing to inspect network traffic.
hints: This card number is deterministic and documented in docs/api/billing.md — no need for a real payment simulator.
The payment form doesn't disappear after a decline, since the invoice is still open — that's intentional, it enables a retry.
